rootCause:
**Likely cause:** AWS Glue Python jobs are experiencing widespread application failures driven by a critical error in the primary job process.

**Confidence:** high

**Supporting evidence:**
- Finding ID 28d2f5bd-bb08-48d7-bc97-9f13f25a826a (critical severity, 27 occurrences) in /aws-glue/python-jobs/error dominates the incident
- Four additional high-severity findings (IDs 92e47312-5d3a-45d9-8ba3-71e09c88ac62 with 19 counts, 04415c07-c6fb-4feb-8120-73e7875dece4 with 14 counts, 38b7fe41-f9b7-4a7e-81a8-0c816b1de56d with 13 counts) all correlate within the same log group with overlapping timeframes (2026-08-26 through 2026-08-28)
- All top correlations (10 documented) show OBSERVED relationships among these five findings in /aws-glue/python-jobs/error
- Category breakdown shows 13 application-level errors as the primary issue type
- Peak occurrence on 2026-08-27 (20 findings) indicates acute failure window concentrated around job execution processes
executiveSummary:
- Is anything wrong: Yes, 1 critical finding and 3 high severity findings detected across 27 total findings
- Biggest issue: Application error in /aws-glue/python-jobs/error affecting all 27 findings with critical severity
- Where: AWS Glue Python jobs error log group with 8 affected groups across the infrastructure
- Recurring: Yes, spike of 20 findings on 2026-08-27 followed by ongoing occurrences totaling 7 findings through 2026-09-02
- Investigate first: Application category errors (13 findings) and access_denied issues (4 findings) after addressing the critical Glue Python job error
